# Three.js r180

Vendored from npm three@0.180.0 (https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js), MIT license in LICENSE. Core modules, GLTFLoader, BufferGeometryUtils and bundled MeshoptDecoder. No runtime CDN requests or package manager required.

References: https://threejs.org/docs/ (GLTFLoader.setMeshoptDecoder, Material.opacity/transparent/depthWrite).
